name: DuckDuckGo
label: DuckDuckGo
description: DuckDuckGo official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: instant_answer. Docs: https://duckduckgo.com/api. Instant Answer API only — not a full SERP. Attribution when displayed. Do not scrape duckduckgo.com HTML. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One DuckDuckGo request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"instant_answer"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: instant_answer. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'instant_answer'.

schema.label: no_html
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `no_html` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: no_redirect
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `no_redirect` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: skip_disambig
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `skip_disambig` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: instant_answer.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
